lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Biscuit was digging at the beach, as usual.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then he found something shiny.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: A shell! A real one! It's mine!

lines.speaker: pim
lines.text: Ooh, can I hold it? Just for a second?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pim's beak drooped all the way down.

lines.speaker: mabel
lines.text: That's a lovely shell. Does it sing?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I don't know. Nobody's listened to it with me.

lines.speaker: mabel
lines.text: Shells sound better when you share them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the next day, Biscuit took his shell back to the beach.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Pim! Want to listen to the sea?

lines.speaker: pim
lines.text: Really? Oh, Biscuit! I can hear it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the shell sounded better than ever.
